question: Kritika lends Rs. 64000 to Nidhi for a year at 25% interest per annum, compounded half yearly. Find the interest that has to be paid by Nidhi.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For half-yearly compounding, Rate (r) = 25% ÷ 2 = 12.5% and Time periods (n) = 2.

Effective interest rate for 2 periods = r + r + (r × r)/100

⇒ Net Rate = 12.5 + 12.5 + (12.5 × 12.5)/100 = 26.5625%

Interest = 64000 × 26.5625% = 64000 × 0.265625 = 17000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 17000.**
